models.model: Sol or Astra (creator-reported; implements the design)

requirements: Codex with its built-in image generation, run on a page or project you want redesigned.
Optional, for Claude Code: Codex installed so Opus can call codex exec, or an OpenAI API key for the Images API (the bulk script needs OPENAI_API_KEY, and image calls cost API credit).

preview.description: A one-line Codex prompt for better-looking pages and games: an image model draws the redesign first, then the coding model implements what it drew. Includes a Claude Code prompt for a bulk image script.
